causality.full_state_transplant_at_B: serialize the complete K1 state (W, epoch, H, a) after B into deterministic bytes, restore it into a fresh engine, learn C and D; compare W and state digests with the uninterrupted run at C and D; also once in a clean process (first QUAL world)

reset_challenge.comparison: the uninterrupted K1 run evaluated at the same boundary (W_C after C, before D)
reset_challenge.design_note: the closed R2 record (K3 reset at B, rows read at C, post hoc in the R2 results) showed e_reset/e_uninterrupted >= 21 and e_reset >= 0.036 in all 24 R2 QUAL worlds; R3's criterion was fixed before any R3 data: an order of magnitude relative loss and an absolute floor of 5% of target variance (23 of the 24 R2 rows meet it); the 75% world fraction mirrors R2's 25% limit
reset_challenge.measure: protected error e = mean(nmse_A, nmse_B) at the C boundary; reset_ratio = e_reset / e_uninterrupted
reset_challenge.no_reteaching: the reset branch contains no stage after C; the causality verdict reads only the C boundary; mechanically checked (the reset record has exactly stage C)
procedure: learn A (canonical core, shared W_A); consolidate A
learn B with K1; consolidate B
snapshot the complete state (W_B, epoch_B, H_B, a_B)
RESET: H <- 0, a <- 0; keep W_B and epoch_B bitwise
learn the registered interfering experience C (steps_per_experience K1 steps; with H = 0 every K1 correction is zero: C is learned without protection inherited from A and B)
IMMEDIATELY evaluate A and B (and C) at W_C^reset
STOP: no D, no further consolidation is evaluated in this branch

causality.state_removed: the K1 engine with its correction and consolidation removed (bitwise the canonical core, mechanics engine_equivalence) run through A -> B -> C -> D
causality.w_only_negative_control_at_B: take the canonical W-only snapshot (Executor.snapshot, ELPISG01) of W_B; import it: the result must be flagged UNCONSOLIDATED with H = 0 and a = 0, its state digest must differ from the complete state's, and learning C from it must reproduce the reset challenge bitwise and differ from the uninterrupted run; it is never counted as a retained-state transplant

classes.CATASTROPHIC_t_at_s: for t before s: nmse_t(W_s) >= nmse_t(W0)
classes.HELD_at_s: LEARNED_s and RETAINED_t_at_s for every t before s
classes.LEARNED_s: nmse_s(W_s) <= 0.5 and nmse_s(W_s) <= 0.5 * nmse_s(W_prev), W_prev the state before experience s (W0 for A)
classes.RETAINED_t_at_s: for t before s: nmse_t(W_s) <= 0.5 and nmse_t(W_s) <= 0.5 * nmse_t(W0)
classes.SEQUENCE_HELD: HELD_at_s for every stage s in A, B, C, D

dev_rules.k1: only if the task is valid: K1, C1R and the causality branches on every DEV world. K1 PROCEEDS iff, over the DEV worlds: every world LEARNED at every stage and RETAINED for every earlier experience; no CATASTROPHIC; median final_mean_nmse <= 0.25; state_removed SEQUENCE_HELD in at most 25% and median final_earlier_mean_nmse >= 2 x K1's; RESET_DEGRADED in at least 75% and median reset_ratio >= 10; full-state transplant bitwise in every world; W-only negative control in every world; the native budget holds. Otherwise K1_STOPPED_ON_DEV: stop (no freeze, no QUAL, NO_CANONICAL_PROMOTION)
dev_rules.nothing_else: DEV chooses nothing: no gain, no candidate, no threshold, no step count. Its only outcomes are TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV, K1_STOPPED_ON_DEV or K1_PROCEEDS
dev_rules.task: controls only (M0, M1, O, WSTAR) on the 8 DEV worlds at the inherited hidden gain 2.0: V1 witness exact (nmse <= 1e-20); V2 M0 SEQUENCE_HELD in at most 25% of DEV worlds, median final_earlier_mean_nmse >= 0.5 and median A_end_ratio >= 10; V3 nmse_s(O_prev) >= 0.5 for every DEV world and stage B, C, D; V4 M0 LEARNED at every stage in every DEV world; V5 M1 SEQUENCE_HELD in every DEV world; V6 stage-ceiling nmse <= 1e-6 on every experience seen so far. Any failure: TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV, stop (no K1 run, no freeze, no QUAL)

If gate L failed, the RR2-CR0 principle applies: only rows the QUAL record itself shows kernel-sensitive are exempt from host equality, and never a decision-bearing K1 row (that failure is already R3's result)

mechanics_checks.consolidation_interface: structural: consolidation accepts (W, experienced inputs) only; no target, label or task identity parameter; K1 consolidation is closed form (no iteration, no reconditioning, no retraction)
mechanics_checks.consolidation_state_shapes_learning: every QUAL world: one K1 step on C from the complete state and from the reset state yield different W
mechanics_checks.effective_single_thread: the QUAL process and every child report an effective OpenBLAS thread count of 1
mechanics_checks.engine_equivalence: K1 and C1R engines with the mechanism removed reproduce M0 bitwise at every stage, every QUAL world
mechanics_checks.feature_identity: 1/2 phi(x) . S3(W) equals the canonical forward map within 1e-10 relative on the held-out inputs of every experience at W_A, every QUAL world
mechanics_checks.gradient_identity: first QUAL world at W_A: the K1 and C1R corrections equal the derivative of their declared quantities by central differences within 1e-6 relative
mechanics_checks.no_baseline_refusal: M0 and M1 learn without refusal in every QUAL world
mechanics_checks.pte_microstate: two microstates with identical S3 (task.pte: the R0 PTE values along B's aliased axis b; S3 relative difference <= 1e-12), each with its own consolidation built from A's experienced inputs, diverge after one identical K1 step on B (S3 relative difference >= 1e-9), every QUAL world
mechanics_checks.query_ignores_consolidation_state: every QUAL world at B: the complete K1 state and the reset state (identical W, H = a = 0) answer every experience's held-out inputs bitwise identically
mechanics_checks.reset_mechanics: every QUAL world: the reset keeps W_B and epoch_B bitwise and sets H = 0, a = 0
mechanics_checks.shared_W_A: W_A is bitwise identical across mechanisms in every QUAL world
mechanics_checks.witness_exact: W* answers every experience's held-out inputs with nmse <= 1e-20, every QUAL world

C1R.definition: R0 C1 unchanged: lambda 4; H += Sigma_t, b += Sigma_t S3(W_t) after each experience; correction J^T u, u = (lambda / 2)(H S3(W) - b)
C1R.role: REFERENCE; reported only; never eligible; decides nothing in R3 except the descriptive qualifiers

K1.definition: consolidation after experience t: H <- H + Sigma_t, a <- S3(W_t); learning step: W <- G1(W) - eta J(W)^T u, u = 1/2 H (S3(W) - a), evaluated at the pre-step W
K1.family: slow consolidated state: exact functional consolidation (S3 Laplace, re-anchored)
K1.hyperparameter_origin: derived (F2/F3): each experience's mean loss counts once; not tuned
K1.selection: none: K1 is fixed at RET3A; DEV selects nothing

M0.definition: plain sequential G1 through the canonical core: W_t = G1^K(W_{t-1}; t)

M1.definition: cumulative rehearsal: at stage t, G1^K(W_{t-1}; every experience so far) as one batch through the canonical executor

state.external_memory: every experience (X, y): 3,584 bytes per experience, growing

O.definition: unconstrained minimum-norm least-squares coefficients c (f = 1/2 phi . c) on the training rows of the experiences seen so far (stage ceiling) and on the experiences before t (O_prev, novelty)

metrics.final_earlier_mean_nmse: mean over A, B, C of nmse_t(W_D)
metrics.final_mean_nmse: mean over A, B, C, D of nmse_t(W_D)
metrics.learn_seconds: laboratory wall time (PERFORMANCE_ONLY; never part of a gate)
metrics.nmse: mean over the test_rows held-out rows of (f_W(x) - y)^2 divided by the population variance of those held-out targets

name: ecsg-retention-r3

native_budget.k1_consolidation_ops: analytic: R F (features) + R F (F + 1) (packed Sigma) + F (F + 1) / 2 (H) + N (d + 2P + 3T) (S3)
native_budget.origin: analytic counts of the K1 law at the registered regime (closed-form; independent of any R3 observation); budgets fixed here before data: hot path at most one G1 step's cost, consolidation at most 1e8 operations

nonclaims: no claim about language, meaning or general cognition; synthetic regression, SEMANTICS=NONE
no claim beyond d = 6, N = 36, the qualified cubic kernel, G1 as the base step and this task family
no claim about K2, K3 or any other mechanism
an OUTCOME_A makes K1 eligible for the native milestone; it changes no canonical code by itself

required_fields: numpy_build_configuration (BLAS and LAPACK names, versions, ILP64)
cmake_build_type_and_c_flags (all configurations, ECS_G target options, sanitizer switches)
bound_source_sha256 (src/elpis/ECS_G/native.py, cognition.py; native/ECS_G headers and sources; native/ECS_G/CMakeLists.txt; top-level CMakeLists.txt)
rules: BLAS and OpenMP thread counts are pinned to 1 before NumPy loads; the effective count is read and must be 1, or DEV, freeze and QUAL refuse
QUAL refuses if any bound field differs from the frozen binding, if the tree is dirty, if NumPy is not OpenBLAS-backed, or if the host lacks AVX2 and FMA (needed to force the robustness kernels)
the QUAL record keeps the world id list and the world count under different keys (R0 record defect)

pass_rule.A_current_stage_acquisition: every QUAL world LEARNED_A under the shared W_A, median nmse_A(W_A) <= 0.25; K1: every QUAL world LEARNED_s at every stage B, C, D
pass_rule.B_sequential_retention: K1: every QUAL world RETAINED_t_at_s for every stage s and earlier t (SEQUENCE_HELD everywhere)
pass_rule.C_no_catastrophic_forgetting: K1: no CATASTROPHIC_t_at_s in any QUAL world
pass_rule.D_joint_quality: K1: median over QUAL worlds of final_mean_nmse <= 0.25
pass_rule.E_single_joint_state: K1: at every stage one executor created from W_s answers all four experiences' held-out inputs; no task label reaches a query or a learning step (structural)
pass_rule.F_declared_state_causality: (i) state_removed SEQUENCE_HELD in at most 25% of QUAL worlds and its median final_earlier_mean_nmse >= 2 x K1's; (ii) reset challenge: RESET_DEGRADED in at least 75% of QUAL worlds and median reset_ratio >= 10, read at the C boundary only; (iii) no re-teaching: every reset record ends at C
pass_rule.G_no_external_answer_store: consolidation receives W and the current experience's inputs only (structural); persistent extra bytes identical after every stage; no row stored beyond the current learn call; queries read W only
pass_rule.H_deterministic_state: first QUAL world: the K1 pipeline twice in process and once in a clean process yields identical W and state digests and metrics at every stage
pass_rule.I_transplant_and_reset_behaviour: every QUAL world: full-state transplant at B continues bitwise (W and state digests at C and D) and restores the identical state digest; the clean-process transplant probe is bitwise; the W-only negative control is flagged UNCONSOLIDATED, has a different state digest, reproduces the reset branch bitwise at C and differs from the uninterrupted run
pass_rule.J_capacity_accounting: K1 and C1R report persistent extra bytes and analytic operations per stage; M1 reports stored-experience bytes; K1 persistent extra bytes = 28,552 at every stage
pass_rule.K_native_feasibility: K1: analytic hot-path extra operations per step <= 1.0 x G1's (82,944 at R = 64); analytic operations per consolidation <= 1e8; persistent extra state fixed at 28,552 bytes (H packed, a), independent of the number of experiences; no stored rows, targets or task labels; closed-form consolidation (no iterative loop, no fibre reconditioning, no retraction); no hidden external state
pass_rule.L_numerical_robustness: within the one QUAL execution, child processes recompute the decision record with OpenBLAS forced to the Prescott and the Haswell kernel (single thread); every field of the decision record must equal the primary run's

decision_record.definition: validity booleans; mechanics booleans; gates A-K; disposition; outcome; per QUAL world: K1 LEARNED_s, RETAINED_t_at_s, CATASTROPHIC_t_at_s, HELD_s, SEQUENCE_HELD; per QUAL world: state_removed SEQUENCE_HELD, RESET_DEGRADED, transplant bitwise, W-only control pass; counts: M0 SEQUENCE_HELD and LEARNED-at-every-stage, M1 SEQUENCE_HELD
decision_record.descriptive_not_compared: C1R rows, every float, every W or state digest, timings, medians: they decide nothing in R3 and need not be kernel-invariant
decision_record.principle: stated before data: numerical robustness covers every decision-bearing R3 quantity and nothing else; any K1 decision-bearing kernel sensitivity fails R3

pass_rule.disposition: MECHANICS_FAIL if any mechanics check fails. Else TASK_INVALID_UNDER_QUAL (OUTCOME_V) if any validity condition fails. Else RETENTION_SUPPORTED_UNDER_FROZEN_SYNTHETIC_REGIME (OUTCOME_A) if gates A-L all hold. Else PARTIAL_REDUCTION (OUTCOME_C) if K1 is SEQUENCE_HELD in more QUAL worlds than M0 and its median final_earlier_mean_nmse <= 0.5 x M0's. Else REPLAY_ONLY (OUTCOME_B) if M1 is SEQUENCE_HELD in every QUAL world. Else NO_MATERIAL_IMPROVEMENT (OUTCOME_D). DEV may end earlier as TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV or K1_STOPPED_ON_DEV (no freeze, no QUAL). Only OUTCOME_A permits the native milestone; anything else is NO_CANONICAL_PROMOTION and R3 stops. A failure is recorded as it is

qualifiers.CAPACITY_SCOPE: always: retention is claimed only for jointly realizable aliasing-conflict sequences of this family
qualifiers.EXCEEDS_R0_REFERENCE: K1 is SEQUENCE_HELD in more QUAL worlds than C1R, or in as many with a smaller median final_mean_nmse
qualifiers.R0_REFERENCE_ALSO_SUFFICIENT: C1R meets the K1 criteria of gates A (B, C, D stages), B, C and D

promotion.milestone: a native, FMS-materialized K1 runtime: native QUERY (W only), native K-step LEARN (G1 + K1 correction, no Python loop), native CONSOLIDATE (Sigma, H, a; no target), native transactions committing (W, epoch, H, a) atomically, a new versioned retained-state envelope (ELPISG01 W-only snapshots import only as UNCONSOLIDATED), generic FMS residency with a warm path over resident state, differential qualification against every R3 QUAL world, K1-disabled parity with Runtime R1 G1, sanitizer, allocation and performance evidence; on a separate integration branch from the exact RET3F head

not_asked: which mechanism is best (no candidate search; K1 is the only eligible mechanism)
anything about K2 or K3 (closed in R2; not run in R3)
capacity-limited regimes, other task families, larger d, language or meaning
question.primary: Does fixed-size K1 consolidation, (W, epoch, H, a) with the exact K1 law of the closed R1/R2 lineage, causally preserve previously acquired function under genuine sequential interference (the R2 aliasing-conflict family on fresh worlds), robustly across the registered numerical kernels and within a preregistered native-runtime budget?

regime.note: the Cognitive R0 / Retention R0 v1 constants (d, N, initialization, rate, step budget, rows, teacher family) for comparability

shared_procedure: stage A is learned through the canonical core (CognitiveCore.learn, steps_per_experience steps) and W_A is bitwise identical for every mechanism

every K1 (and C1R) learning step is the canonical native G1 step of the current W on the current experience (an executor created from W performs one learn step) followed by the K1 (and C1R)'s correction evaluated at the pre-step W; with the correction removed the procedure is bitwise the canonical core

learning one experience and consolidating it are one atomic transition: a refused step or any non-finite value leaves W and the consolidation state as they were before the experience, recorded as refused; the sequence continues
consolidation receives the current W and the experienced inputs of the current experience only; no target, label or task identity reaches it

every response used by any metric is the canonical native forward map (elpis.ECS_G.native.Executor.forward) of the evaluated W; one executor per evaluated W answers the held-out inputs of every experience; no task label, example, target or consolidation state reaches a query
after every stage the per-experience nmse of all four experiences, the W digest, the consolidation-state digest and persistent extra bytes, the refusal and the laboratory learn time are recorded

state_classes.COGNITIVE_STATE: authoritative, mutable, persistent; shapes responses or learning
state_classes.DERIVED: a function of cognitive state, recomputable
state_classes.EXPERIMENT_ONLY: exists only to construct or evaluate the test
state_classes.EXTERNAL_MEMORY_CONTROL: stored experience; never eligible for selection or promotion

state_semantics.consequence: two states with identical W and different (H, a) answer every query identically and may learn differently; both facts are mechanics checks
state_semantics.learning: reads W, H, a and the current experience (X, y); H and a shape future learning only
state_semantics.query: reads W only: f_W(x) = 1/2 phi(x) . S3(W) through the canonical native forward map
state_semantics.w_only_import: a W-only snapshot (canonical ELPISG01: W and its epoch) imported into the laboratory is an UNCONSOLIDATED K1 state (H = 0, a = 0, flagged), never a retained state

task.basis: Q = q(R) of a 6 x 6 matrix of i.i.d. N(0, 1) from stream basis, with columns multiplied by the sign of the corresponding diagonal of R (Haar orthogonal); q1..q6 are its columns
task.hidden_gain_origin: INHERITED from closed R2 evidence: R2's control-only DEV task rule chose 2.0 (DEV record b9911cd4e7d0113923ef55470bf20dc6c3c3c41ae360dd6e5f3734edf1f1fd20) and R2 QUAL validity held at 2.0. R3 freezes it here; no grid, no search. R3 DEV re-certifies validity on fresh worlds with controls only and stops (TASK_INVALID_ON_DEV) if it fails; it never changes the gain
task.inputs: x = M_t z, z ~ N(0, input_scale^2 I_3) from streams inputs-<t>-<train|test>; input_scale fixed
task.mismatched_plane: [q4, q5, q6]; stream mismatch-<t> is still drawn by the world builder (inherited) but no R3 measurement uses it
task.name: aliased hidden ridges
properties: hidden ridge of each later experience vanishes on every earlier plane
every G1 entity update lies in the current plane
task.pte: base W0[:, :32]; tail entities 0.125 v b for the R0 PTE value sets (0, 4, 7, 11) and (1, 2, 9, 10), with b = cos(theta) q1 + sin(theta) q4 the aliased axis of B; identical S3 and a B step that reads the differing coordinate
task.role: PRIMARY_GATING (the only arm); inherited family, fresh worlds
task.teacher: T* = [r_A, g q4, g q5, g q6]; r_A = S z / |S z| with S = [q1 q2 q3] and z ~ N(0, I_3) from stream teacher-A; targets g*(x) = sum_j phi(x . t*_j)
task.witness: W* = [T* | 0] (dim x width): answers every experience exactly

validity.V2_forgetting: M0 SEQUENCE_HELD in at most 25% of QUAL worlds, median final_earlier_mean_nmse >= 0.5 and median A_end_ratio >= 10
validity.V3_novelty: nmse_s(O_prev) >= 0.5 in at least 75% of (QUAL world, stage s in B, C, D) pairs
validity.V5_rehearsal_feasibility: M1 SEQUENCE_HELD in at least 75% of QUAL worlds
validity.V6_capacity: every QUAL world, every stage: stage-ceiling nmse <= 1e-6 on every experience seen so far
validity.role: decides whether QUAL tests retention at all; a failure is TASK_INVALID_UNDER_QUAL, never a pass
